# autosar-agent-skills

> Zero-dependency (Python standard library) tooling for AUTOSAR Classic Platform
> and CAN communication matrix engineering. Targets bugs that compile cleanly and
> only surface during ECU integration testing. MIT licensed.

## Tools

- [dbc-matrix-audit](https://autosar-skills.github.io/autosar-agent-skills/dbc-matrix-audit.html):
  DBC communication matrix auditor. 11 structural checks (bit-field overlap,
  out-of-range signals, left/right asymmetry, naming drift, GBK encoding),
  14 two-revision diff codes, live frame decoding, CSV export. Exit code 1 on
  error, so it works as a CI gate.

- [arxml-dbc-consistency](https://autosar-skills.github.io/autosar-agent-skills/arxml-dbc-consistency.html):
  Cross-validates ARXML ECUC configuration (Com / PduR / CanIf / CanDrv) against
  a DBC matrix. 26 check codes covering CAN ID binding, DLC, bit geometry, byte
  order, init values, PduR routing and TX/RX direction.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/autosar-skills/autosar-agent-skills) — MIT,
  single-file implementations, 65 unit tests, reproducible packaging.

## Scope

Static analysis only. No bus simulation and no runtime verification: a clean run
means the configuration is internally consistent and consistent with the matrix,
not that the network works.

## Background

- [Designing an engineering-grade skill for an AI agent](https://me.tech-harry.top/blog/dbc-matrix-audit-skill.en.html)
- [105 errors, 99 of them were not real](https://me.tech-harry.top/blog/arxml-dbc-consistency.en.html)
